'''Besaama''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
When Besaama was twelve, she discovered [[the Tree]], a tree that was used as a base by the [[Wyrd]], while walking home through the jungles of Cularin. She entered the tree and two days later, she re-emerged as a member of the Wyrd, having given in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Besaama was later redeemed and she abandoned the dark side.
